'''Hunting blasters''' were the sportsman's version of the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. They were very similar to the [[sporting blaster rifle]].<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>

==Description==
A hunting blaster was a short-range weapon sometimes used for hunting small game.

==Usage==
The hunting blaster was used in sport shooting and hunting. It was also used as a personal defense blaster because of its accuracy, which is due to an extended [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. It was common among the members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="TRG1" /> even [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] wielded one in the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
